checks: All-record structure, timestamps, header values and flags; all deviations retained.
Windowed signed I/Q decode with documented2k+1 correction; sample format/rate read from header, not assumed.
Match only exact station/time/sample-rate/resolution grids; retain/report unmatched records separately, no result-driven row trimming.
Compute raw baseband complex character and lag1sample/lag1second differences; no phase unwrapping. This is explicitly baseband until reference phase mapping is derived.

Under explicitly conditional unsaturated ideal midrise quantizer, compute corner/disk phase-representation enclosure and error amplification. Extreme signed codes flagged as potentially unbounded/clipped, not silently bounded.
Quantiles/counts of amplitudes, ADC-cell angular ranges and character widths; every valid-window pair retained independent of quality flag. No sigma clipping, fitting or gravity parameter estimate.
NCO/LO header reconstruction only with documented sign/time mapping; if ambiguous, record failure, do not select convention to improve coherence.
errors_not_supplied: quantizer transfer law and true clipping history

no_inference: ADC representation bounds and dependent receiver format checks are not scalar observations or physical noise limits.
